_about: Dota item actives and passives in the engine's effect tree (docs/DOTA_PACK.md). Same format and rules as abilities.json: values are references to the item's dotaconstants keys ("$key"); "passive" is one modifier template merged into the item's stat bonuses, "active" is an ability (id item_<item>). status: full or simplified (with a note).

basher.note: the melee chance for every hero (ranged heroes have the ranged chance in Dota)

black_king_bar.note: basic dispel, debuff immunity and the magic resistance: no immunity to pure and reflected damage
